title: A Bridge for the Regiment
author: Petra Okafor
blurb: Coral Voss, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, has spent ten years learning which silences keep people safe. But when the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the century turns.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
